Research and apply advanced reasoning methods, including Chain-of-Thought and multi-step planning techniques
Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT, Claude, LLaMA, and Gemini with agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex)
Apply local model optimization techniques, including fine-tuning, quantization, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines
Optimize inference performance, scalability, and cost efficiency for enterprise-scale deployments
Collaborate with product managers, system architects, and UX designers to translate technical capabilities into user-facing product features
Write and maintain technical documentation, architectural specifications, and best practice guidelines
Extend LLM capabilities beyond text generation, enabling them to function as autonomous, action-oriented Agents
Drive innovation in reasoning, planning, and multi-agent collaboration to unlock new AI capabilities
Bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and real-world product implementation
Empower businesses to automate workflows, perform intelligent data analysis, and achieve operational efficiency at scale
Shape the next generation of AI-powered enterprise applications and solutions
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field; Master’s degree preferred
3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, with exposure to LLMs and agent-based frameworks
Proficiency in Python; familiarity with TypeScript/JavaScript is a plus
Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or LlamaIndex
Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta) and open-source models (LLaMA, Mistral, Falcon, Yi, Qwen, etc.)
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and reasoning techniques (CoT/ToT)
Experience with database technologies (SQL, NoSQL, vector databases) and API integration
Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and product teams
Experience with MLOps/DevOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines)
Knowledge of distributed systems and scalable AI architectures
Contributions to open-source AI projects (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, Hugging Face)
Experience with multimodal AI applications (speech, vision, video)
Domain expertise in industries such as SaaS, finance, retail, or e-commerce
